timeline.summary: Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹342.82 Cr (+13.1% YoY), net profit ₹107.81 Cr (-9.7% YoY).
On October 19, 2026, Just Dial reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹342.82 Cr (+13.1% YoY) and net profit of ₹107.81 Cr (-9.7% YoY).
Central Consumer Protection Authority imposed a Rs.10 Lakh penalty on Just Dial on 28 October 2026; the company discontinued listing of ammonium nitrate on its platform.
